name: Febric
about: Febric is the older son of Vil and Daia, the co-family who share child-raising with Gladias and Seila, and a keen young programmer. The book barely describes him beyond his age and his gadgets, so this look is invented and contributors are welcome to replace it.

facts.quote: carrying his hand device in one hand, attached by a cable to a larger compute box in the other
facts.fact: Carries a hand device cabled to a compute box.

facts.quote: a teenage boy, not quite an adult

facts.fact: Vil is his father; calls Gladias and Seila uncle and aunt.

facts.quote: I coded two different kinds of bounded-depth trees from scratch
A waiter handed Febric a tea in a cup with a sealed lid.

descriptor: a lanky young man of about seventeen, tall and narrow-shouldered, pale skin with rosy cheeks, straight ash-blond hair falling over his ears and rectangular black-framed glasses, wearing a faded teal hooded half-cape over one shoulder above a fitted grey undertunic, rust-brown ribbed trousers gathered at the ankle, soft grey seamless shoes, and a cross-body harness holding a compact grey box cabled to the small handheld screen in his hand
